<documents>
<document id="docs-account-details">
FindingˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆYourˆroutingˆnumberˆandˆaccountˆnumberˆareˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆAccountˆdetails.ˆYou'llˆneedˆthemˆforˆdirectˆdeposit,ˆtoˆlinkˆTallowbrookˆatˆanotherˆbank,ˆorˆtoˆreceiveˆaˆwire.ˆ##ˆWhereˆtoˆfindˆthemˆTapˆProfile,ˆthenˆAccountˆdetails.ˆTapˆtheˆeyeˆiconˆtoˆshowˆtheˆfullˆaccountˆnumber.ˆTheˆappˆasksˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆit'sˆyouˆfirst.ˆ##ˆCardˆnumberˆversusˆaccountˆnumberˆYourˆcardˆnumberˆisˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆaccountˆnumber.ˆDon'tˆgiveˆyourˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆanˆemployerˆforˆdirectˆdeposit.ˆ##ˆKeepingˆthemˆsafeˆOnlyˆgiveˆyourˆaccountˆandˆroutingˆnumbersˆtoˆpeopleˆandˆcompaniesˆyouˆtrust,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployer.ˆSomeoneˆwithˆtheseˆnumbersˆcanˆtryˆtoˆpullˆmoneyˆbyˆACH.ˆIfˆthatˆhappens,ˆyouˆcanˆdisputeˆit.ˆ##ˆSupportˆwon'tˆreadˆthemˆoutˆForˆsecurity,ˆsupportˆwon'tˆreadˆyourˆfullˆaccountˆnumberˆorˆcardˆnumberˆtoˆyouˆinˆchatˆorˆonˆtheˆphone.ˆYouˆcanˆalwaysˆseeˆthemˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆWireˆinstructionsˆForˆincomingˆwires,ˆuseˆtheˆWireˆinstructionsˆscreenˆunderˆAccountˆdetails,ˆwhichˆalsoˆshowsˆourˆSWIFTˆcodeˆforˆinternationalˆwires.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="account-eligibility">
WhoˆcanˆopenˆanˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆopenˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆifˆyou:ˆ-ˆAreˆatˆleastˆ18ˆyearsˆoldˆ-ˆLiveˆinˆtheˆUSˆandˆhaveˆaˆUSˆresidentialˆaddressˆ(notˆaˆPOˆbox)ˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆSocialˆSecurityˆnumberˆorˆITINˆ-ˆHaveˆanˆunexpiredˆgovernment-issuedˆphotoˆIDˆ-ˆHaveˆaˆsmartphoneˆthatˆcanˆrunˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆ##ˆOpeningˆanˆaccountˆDownloadˆtheˆappˆandˆtapˆGetˆstarted.ˆYou'llˆenterˆyourˆdetails,ˆtakeˆaˆphotoˆofˆyourˆIDˆandˆaˆselfie.ˆEveryˆaccountˆstartsˆonˆBasic,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆplansˆonceˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆOneˆaccountˆperˆpersonˆEachˆpersonˆcanˆhaveˆoneˆTallowbrookˆaccount.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆjointˆaccounts,ˆbusinessˆaccountsˆorˆaccountsˆforˆpeopleˆunderˆ18.ˆ##ˆLivingˆabroadˆIfˆyouˆmoveˆabroadˆpermanently,ˆyouˆmayˆneedˆtoˆcloseˆyourˆaccount.ˆTellˆusˆbeforeˆyouˆmove.ˆ##ˆPreviouslyˆclosedˆbyˆusˆIfˆTallowbrookˆclosedˆanˆaccountˆofˆyoursˆinˆtheˆpast,ˆaˆnewˆapplicationˆmayˆbeˆdeclined.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfers-brookpay">
SendingˆmoneyˆwithˆBrookPayˆBrookPayˆletsˆyouˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆTallowbrookˆmemberˆbyˆphoneˆnumber,ˆemailˆorˆusername.ˆIt'sˆfree,ˆitˆworksˆeveryˆday,ˆandˆtheˆmoneyˆarrivesˆinˆseconds.ˆ##ˆSendˆmoneyˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆBrookPay.ˆChooseˆtheˆperson,ˆenterˆtheˆamountˆandˆconfirm.ˆTheˆrecipientˆseesˆtheˆmoneyˆstraightˆaway.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆBrookPayˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆBrookPayˆandˆexternalˆtransfersˆareˆlimitedˆtoˆ$500.ˆ##ˆBrookPayˆcan'tˆbeˆreversedˆOnceˆaˆBrookPayˆpaymentˆisˆsent,ˆitˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆorˆpulledˆback,ˆevenˆbyˆsupport.ˆOnlyˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆpeopleˆyouˆknow.ˆIfˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆtheˆwrongˆperson,ˆaskˆthemˆtoˆsendˆitˆback.ˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyouˆwereˆscammed,ˆreportˆitˆtoˆusˆrightˆaway.ˆ##ˆFeesˆBrookPayˆcostsˆ$0.00ˆonˆeveryˆplan.ˆBrookPayˆonlyˆworksˆbetweenˆTallowbrookˆmembers.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
